title: 2x Runner Bean 'Moonlight' Plug Plants – Self-Setting, Stringless, Reliable Crop
description:
Product Details:     
Self-setting:  Sets pods well, even in poor UK summers.    
High yield:  Produces lots of smooth, fleshy, stringless pods up to 10" (25cm) long.    
Early and continuous cropping:  Starts early and keeps producing, even in bad weather.    
Awarded:  RHS Award of Merit.    

Growing Instructions:    
Plant in well-prepared soil with added organic matter.   
Needs support (canes, wires, or netting) to climb.   Water well, especially when flowering.   
Protect young plants from pests.  
 Pick beans regularly to keep plants producing.
